title: Unify packaged operation contracts and typed routed actions

intent.outcome: Close issues #2197 and #2298 through one operation-contract authority lane: first make packaged external operation resources deterministic from one canonical generator, then make ordinary routed actions derive identity, arguments, effects, preconditions, transitions, retry identity, claim effects, and exact manual renderings from typed invocations.
non_goals: Do not create a second operation or readiness authority.
Do not preserve shell command parsing as ordinary machine identity.
Do not broaden the stack beyond #2197 and #2298 or alter unrelated Planning owners.

completion_criteria: Both supported generators reach the same idempotent fixed point from either execution order and packaged Python/TypeScript operation contracts remain equal and complete.
Ordinary routed actions expose authoritative typed invocations and actionability compares them without parsing command text.
The #2864 invalid defaults rendering and #2865 integration preview/continuation divergence are covered by regression tests generated from the same typed source.
Compact machine projections remain executable without command text, while explicit human projections render exact supported commands.
Focused, package-wide, generated parity, and exact changed-path proof pass; both issues have PR-linked closure evidence.
